label: States Kit
description: The four states every list and screen needs: Loading (an inline spinner plus a full-area overlay with a Visible input), Empty (glyph, title, hint and an optional action button with a Clicked signal), Error (message plus a Retry signal output), and Skeleton placeholders (a pulsing text row and a card). Each state is its own component, styled with the project design tokens, with a Demo component showing them together.
